summary: Starling Oncology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary SOM, LLC entered a $25 million revolving credit facility with Gemino Healthcare Finance (d/b/a SLR Healthcare ABL) on August 20, 2026. The facility matures August 20, 2029, bears availability tied to a receivables borrowing base, and is secured by a first-priority interest in substantially all of SOM, LLC's collateral; supported professional corporations must enter lockbox arrangements. Approximately $4.75 million was outstanding at the August 21, 2026 closing date, with proceeds earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. This routine credit facility is not a special situation.
